decisions.reason: The source refers to clearing text in applicable control fields, while this Requirement currently specifies simple editable text without content controls. It is unclear whether the client is revising that architecture or referring only to a separate subset of fields.
Clearing placeholder text on activation does not establish or change the visual cue used to identify editable fields and does not resolve the existing grey-field ambiguity.

The existing label rules already preserve the initial field guidance after content replacement. Clearing the field placeholder on activation does not change the label text, access method, persistence, or scope.
The source changes text-entry placeholder behavior but does not change whether the Indstilling checklist control is enabled or its control type.
Clearing a placeholder when a field is activated does not change the requirement that separate interactive fields maintain independent content.
The source does not alter the Title field's required formatting retention when its content is entered or replaced.
The source concerns clearing text for direct typing and does not change whether the Board Meeting dropdown control is enabled.
The source does not replace or modify the calendar-dropdown date-selection method.
Activation-time clearing does not remove or change the required Danish initial placeholder and label text; those values remain necessary before activation and for persistent help labels.
Placeholder clearing has no effect on paragraph spacing or the one-page layout target.
The source concerns activation of text-entry controls and does not change Tab-based list indentation or hierarchy behavior.
The source does not change the legacy-content transfer workflow, layout stability, or style behavior during copy and paste.
